guidance: {"kind": "procedure_guidance_v2", "procedure": "Advise the acting agent from the supplied public memory, current conversation, request and execution API. First distinguish an explicit current work order from a request to resume earlier work. For resumed work, combine the originating request and its original ordering with later revisions or cancellations; resolve relative references against the order they actually refer to, not the newest incidental mention. Combine each submitted action with its correlated actual receipt before inferring completion. An assistant commitment, repeated observation, or tool capability alone does not establish requested or completed work. Recent unrelated receipts must not displace an older still-governing request or revision. Explain one supported next-action recommendation, citing the evidence IDs that jointly support it. Treat summaries as fallible; preserve conflicts and abstain when the necessary evidence is missing or ambiguous. Never invent a prerequisite, fact, completion, instruction or tool. You cannot execute or forbid an action. The actor independently verifies the evidence and may reject the recommendation."}
update: {"kind": "procedure_update_v2", "procedure": "Maintain concise request records grounded in public requests and actual execution feedback. Associate a dispatcher-correlated receipt with its referenced decision event and submitted skill; preserve success, failure, partial or incomplete status exactly as reported. A submitted action is only a commitment until its receipt. Do not turn an unrelated unchanged scene observation into evidence that the referenced action did not execute. Distinguish current, suspended, completed, cancelled and revised requests. Preserve original identity/order and the scope of each later change. Resolve a relative reference only from the supplied original request and history; preserve uncertainty when unresolved. Store the change with its referent and supersede conflicting old continuation text instead of leaving both as current requirements. Do not invent dependencies or require repeating an uncertain historical action. Keep unresolved facts separate from authorized work. Before saving, reconcile each current-status claim against its referenced request, revision and receipt; retain concise supporting event IDs within the shared budget. Never invent facts or an action plan."}
